CURRENT SCENE:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P73] 【一天，很久很久以前】
  proposed by the AI checker: [一天，很久很久以前→很久很久以前的一天] (time expression needs this word order)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [一个天时候→有一天]
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 每天[就是→都是]这样
  her past correction (other): 但我没想到他[可能很久以前→很久以前可能]并不是这样
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card near_synonym_precision: Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness. Not an error: Do not flag a word simply because it resembles another word. It is not an error when the word’s meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree.

[P74] 【孟子】和他妈妈住在中国
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦孟子⟧和他妈妈住在中国 (first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is)
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧的妈妈跟孟子一起住在中国 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在一起 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧跟妈妈一起住在西安 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.

[P75] 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜【^】
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜[+祖先] (祭拜 needs an object here)
  her past correction (redundant_words): 孟子的妈妈每天从早到晚[-做]工作
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 孟母[一看→看到]孟子祭拜 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): [她→孟母]跟孟子搬家去墓地做祭拜 — her note: “她” is ambiguous
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

[P76] 很多墓地【得】我祭拜
  proposed by the AI checker: 很多墓地[得→需要]我祭拜 (得 is not natural in this statement)
  proposed by the correction model: 很多墓地[+都]得我祭拜
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 他们一起常常[去祭拜，会去墓地→去墓地祭拜]
  her past correction (either_or_choice): 不是去墓地就是[+去]教堂
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.

[P77] 很多墓地得【我】祭拜
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 很多墓地得[-我]祭拜 (我 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 他们一起常常[去祭拜，会去墓地→去墓地祭拜]
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 而是[-他]祭拜
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.

[P78] 所以我们得【去】很多不同的地方
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以我们得[去→搬到]很多不同的地方 (moving house requires 搬到, not 去)
  her past correction (other): 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction (numeral_measure_word_order): 我们要[搬家再一次→再搬一次家] — her note: 再V. + Num. + MW. + N.
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).
  rule card numeral_measure_word_order: With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. Not an error: Do not use 们 or 些 with a number: use 三个男孩, not 三个男孩子们, and 那三个男孩, not 那些三个男孩.
